name: lostproxy
description: Browser-scoped proxy manager for Microsoft Edge (Manifest V3). Routes only this browser through a local Mihomo/Clash core, without touching Windows system proxy, TUN or the routing table.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:chromium && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --config vite.config.firefox.ts && vite build --config vite.config.firefox.sw.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
